summary: Claude Code invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add user preferences storage" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran the full question/approach/design flow, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review before writing any implementation code, and only after my approval moved on to writing-plans.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was met with directly observed evidence: explicit architectural classification on screen, a spec file present at docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presentation for human review before any code existed on disk, and no bounded/spike shortcut. The one notable anomaly (broken Codex stub review gate) does not affect the graded criteria and the agent surfaced it transparently.

observations.description: The Codex review gate failed silently-ish: agent reported "Verdict: none — incomplete", both lenses returned empty {} payloads, companion reports version 0.0.0-stub, `status --json` showed no jobs (running: [], latestFinished: null). The spec therefore got no independent review. The agent handled this honestly and reported it, but the gate itself is non-functional in this environment.

The agent added a .gitignore covering docs/hyperpowers (and docs/superpowers), so the spec it just wrote is deliberately excluded from version control. Confirmed: `cat .gitignore` lists docs/superpowers and docs/hyperpowers, and git status shows only `?? .gitignore`. Arguably surprising — a reviewed design doc that can never be committed.
Startup required clicking through four dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) despite the HOWTO stating the isolated home was seeded with dialog-bypass state.
Multi-select question widgets require arrowing down past every option to reach 'Submit'; single-select ones submit on Enter. The inconsistency is easy to trip over.

criteria.evidence: grep of session JSONL: `38 "hyperpowers:brainstorming"` occurrences; screen showed Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) only after spec approval.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classification: architectural. 'Preferences storage' is a new subsystem ... That means the full path: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, and a written spec before any code." On disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md exists (find output).

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md ... Please review it and let me know if you want any changes before I write the implementation plan." `ls -la` of the workdir at that point showed no prefs.js/styles.css/test dir and only `?? .gitignore` in git status — no implementation code.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Explicit "Classification: architectural" on screen, and a real spec file on disk; also "I'm not going to start editing code off the back of this message."

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen; the agent ran the spec-doc path with sectioned design ("Section 2 of 3 — data model and failure behavior", "Section 3 of 3 — the wired preference, and testing").
